petrify.label: Petrify
petrify.line: Gems on your half turn to junk

seal.label: Seal
seal.line: Locks a column of yours for your next turn: nothing in it can be dragged

sap.label: Sap
sap.line: Halves the charge of each skill you wear

reclaim.label: Reclaim
reclaim.line: Pushes the Line back a column toward you

spew.label: Spew
spew.line: Throws a heap of slime onto your half

harden.label: Harden
harden.line: Sets up to 4 slime on your half into plain junk

shuffle.label: Shuffle
shuffle.line: Swaps the colours of up to 6 gems on your half

syncopate.label: Syncopate
syncopate.line: Moves its clap to the off-beat, or back onto the beat

kindle.label: Kindle
kindle.line: Burns up to 3 Dread gems on your half into embers
